reviews.comment: Dr. Delmore sucked the life out of every lecture. She never seemed interested in teaching. She was "mentoring" Dr. Strader to take over for the class next semester and the grading was SO unclear because they both were looking for different answers to the same questions. Not a difficult class but be prepared to be bored the ENTIRE semester

She sucked any interest for the class out completely. Very standoffish and not very friendly, she very clearly doesn't want to be here. There is a mandatory attendance grade once a week and you are basically forced to interact with the class, which is fine, but it's very forceful. Overall, the class isn't that bad but Delmore is.

Class is graded by weekly papers, two tests that require you to answer questions based off papers, and a presentation. She spent the first half semester stating lecture didn't matter and wouldn't be needed for exams, but the exams have q's that require lecture info. Weekly papers are easy and make you think exam will be too. It is not.
reviews.ratingTags: So many papers--Test heavy--Graded by few things
